name: Will adding a pantry let me use fewer kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Will adding a pantry let me use fewer kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pantry does not automatically eliminate kitchen cabinets; it changes what each cabinet needs to do. Elite Remodeling & Design can compare pantry storage with drawer bases, appliance garages, refrigerator panels, and everyday kitchen cabinets so frequently used items stay close to the work zones. Moving too much into a remote pantry may create extra walking during meal preparation. Conversely, storing bulk or rarely used items in the pantry can free prime kitchen drawers and counters. Make a list of daily, weekly, and occasional-use items before deciding what leaves the kitchen. The best plan usually divides storage by frequency rather than placing everything in one room.
acceptedAnswer.description: Possibly, but not necessarily. A pantry can hold bulk and occasional-use goods while kitchen cabinets keep daily items near cooking and cleanup zones. Elite Remodeling & Design can divide storage by frequency so the pantry adds capacity without making meal preparation less convenient.
